2026-08-03:Banxico Survey of Expectation.title: Banxico Survey of Expectations
2026-08-03:Banxico Survey of Expectation.what: Updates private-sector economists' forecasts for growth, inflation and the policy rate.
2026-08-03:Banxico Survey of Expectation.why: It shows whether analysts are shifting their rate-path and inflation calls ahead of the August 6 decision.

2026-08-03:Banxico remittances — June da.title: Remittances (June data)
2026-08-03:Banxico remittances — June da.what: Updates monthly remittance inflows into Mexico.
2026-08-03:Banxico remittances — June da.why: Remittances are a major household-income and FX-supply channel, so a change here feeds directly into peso liquidity and consumer spending reads.

2026-08-06:Banxico monetary-policy decis.title: Monetary-policy decision
2026-08-06:Banxico monetary-policy decis.what: Sets Banco de México's overnight target rate.
2026-08-06:Banxico monetary-policy decis.why: The rate level shapes borrowing costs and the peso, and this is the first decision after the early-August expectations survey.

2026-08-07:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Ju.title: CPI (July, headline and core)
2026-08-07:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Ju.what: Updates headline and core consumer-price inflation for July.
2026-08-07:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Ju.why: This is the last full inflation print before the next Banxico meeting and will factor into that rate call.

2026-08-25:Foreign direct investment — H.title: Foreign direct investment (H1 2026)
2026-08-25:Foreign direct investment — H.what: Updates quarterly foreign-direct-investment inflows for the first half of 2026.
2026-08-25:Foreign direct investment — H.why: FDI flows signal how much external capital is committing to Mexico, relevant given nearshoring narratives tied to the country.

2026-09-01:Presidential Informe de Gobie.title: Presidential Informe de Gobierno
2026-09-01:Presidential Informe de Gobie.what: Delivers the constitutional state-of-the-nation report that opens the legislative year.
2026-09-01:Presidential Informe de Gobie.why: It sets the tone and priorities Congress will work from just before the 2027 budget package is due.

2026-09-08:Paquete Económico 2027 delive.title: Paquete Económico 2027 delivered
2026-09-08:Paquete Económico 2027 delive.what: Submits the government's proposed 2027 revenue and spending framework to Congress.
2026-09-08:Paquete Económico 2027 delive.why: This is the first concrete look at next year's fiscal stance, including deficit and spending plans, ahead of legislative negotiation.

2026-09-16:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.title: US Fed policy decision
2026-09-16:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.what: Sets the US federal funds target rate, with updated economic projections.
2026-09-16:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.why: US rate moves affect the peso and Mexican financial conditions given close trade and capital-flow ties, and this meeting includes the Fed's updated forecasts.

2026-09-24:Banxico monetary-policy decis.title: Monetary-policy decision
2026-09-24:Banxico monetary-policy decis.what: Sets Banco de México's overnight target rate.
2026-09-24:Banxico monetary-policy decis.why: This decision follows the Fed's September meeting and the delivery of the 2027 budget package, both of which could shape Banxico's calculus.

2026-10-28:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.title: US Fed policy decision
2026-10-28:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.what: Sets the US federal funds target rate.
2026-10-28:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.why: Fed moves influence peso valuation and cross-border capital flows relevant to Mexico's own rate path.

2026-10-31:Ley de Ingresos 2027 — Senate.title: Ley de Ingresos 2027 approval deadline
2026-10-31:Ley de Ingresos 2027 — Senate.what: Fixes the federal revenue and debt ceilings for 2027 as approved by the Senate.
2026-10-31:Ley de Ingresos 2027 — Senate.why: This locks in the legal revenue and borrowing limits the government can work within for next year.

2026-11-05:Banxico monetary-policy decis.title: Monetary-policy decision
2026-11-05:Banxico monetary-policy decis.what: Sets Banco de México's overnight target rate.
2026-11-05:Banxico monetary-policy decis.why: This meeting comes right after the Fed's late-October decision and the Senate's approval of the 2027 revenue law, both inputs to the rate call.

2026-11-15:Presupuesto de Egresos 2027 —.title: Presupuesto de Egresos 2027 deadline
2026-11-15:Presupuesto de Egresos 2027 —.what: Constitutional deadline for Mexico's Chamber of Deputies to approve the 2027 federal spending budget.
2026-11-15:Presupuesto de Egresos 2027 —.why: The approved figures set how much the federal government can spend by sector for 2027, shaping fiscal policy for the year ahead.

2026-12-09:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.title: Fed rate decision with projections
2026-12-09:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.what: The FOMC sets its federal funds rate target and releases updated economic projections, including the dot plot.
2026-12-09:US Fed (FOMC) monetary-policy.why: This meeting pairs the rate call with fresh Fed forecasts, giving the clearest signal yet on the likely path of US rates into next year.

2026-12-17:Banxico monetary-policy decis.title: Banxico monetary-policy decision
2026-12-17:Banxico monetary-policy decis.what: Sets Banco de México's overnight policy interest rate, the last decision of 2026.
2026-12-17:Banxico monetary-policy decis.why: As the year's final meeting, my read is it will shape rate expectations heading into 2027 more than a mid-year decision would.

2026-09-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Au.title: CPI (INPC), August
2026-09-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Au.what: Updates Mexico's headline and core consumer-price inflation for August.
2026-09-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Au.why: Inflation readings feed directly into Banxico's rate decisions, so this release shapes expectations for borrowing costs.

2026-10-08:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Se.title: CPI (INPC), September
2026-10-08:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Se.what: Updates Mexico's headline and core consumer-price inflation for September.
2026-10-08:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Se.why: This is the last full inflation print before Banxico's next policy meeting, so it carries extra weight for rate-path expectations.

2026-11-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Oc.title: CPI (INPC), October
2026-11-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Oc.what: Updates Mexico's headline and core consumer-price inflation for October.
2026-11-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, Oc.why: Shows whether inflation is holding near target or drifting, a key input for Banxico's next rate call.

2026-12-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, No.title: CPI (INPC), November
2026-12-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, No.what: Updates Mexico's headline and core consumer-price inflation for November.
2026-12-09:INEGI CPI — monthly (INPC, No.why: Comes ahead of year-end policy decisions, so it matters for how Banxico frames inflation risk into 2027.
